annotations.title: Evaluate an x402 payment (read-only, never signs)

description: verify the recipient. Call this BEFORE signing any x402 payment. Verdict is pay | review | do_not_pay, each with stable reason codes (e.g. 'amount 1.00 USDC exceeds max_amount 0.05 USDC'). Fail-closed by design: do not invent authority — when policy, identity, cost or evidence is missing the answer is a refusal or a review, never a pay. A `review` verdict also carries a `packet` object with the amount and its share of the applicable cap, the payee, the rule that fired, the checks run and skipped, and the one decision being asked of the human; `pay` and `do_not_pay` do not. Returns the decision plus a signed receipt you can verify offline with verify_receipt, and a `bundle_id` naming the evidence bundle for this call (events, hashed inputs, receipt, summary). Read-only: holds no keys, never signs, never moves funds. A refusal costs nothing. This tool evaluates locally, so it makes no network calls and returns no seller reputation; the hosted HTTP API adds `seller_reputation` (domain and certificate age) because it can reach the network.

agent_id.description: Which agent is asking. Required to reach per-agent budgets in policy.agents.

payment_identifier.description: The x402 payment-identifier for this challenge, if the seller or client supplies one. Passing the same value on a retry turns the second verdict into `review` instead of a second `pay`, because a retried preflight is not a second approval.

name: evaluate_mcp_payment
